sloka: स सत्य वादी धर्म आत्मा गाम्भीर्यात् सागर उपमः ।आकाशैव निष्पन्को नर इन्द्रः प्रत्युवाच तम् ॥२-३४-९॥
transliteration: sa satya vādī dharma ātmā gāmbhīryāt sāgara upamaḥ ।ākāśaiva niṣpanko nara indraḥ pratyuvāca tam ॥2-34-9॥

translations.english: That truthful and virtuous king (Dasaratha) who was deep like the ocean and free from mud (pure) like the sky replied:
